topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I've been staring at my phone for the past half hour, the message from Sarah just sitting there, unread. I've read it a dozen times, but it doesn’t feel real. It says she's moving, like it's just a simple update, but it's not. It means I'll wake up and she won’t be a text away, a quick drive over. I keep thinking about all the plans we made, all the 'somedays' that won't happen now. I should call her, but my fingers hover above the call button, a million things to say, but nothing comes to mind. I just don't know how to make this okay.
